main: Studio prides itself on vibrant, culture-led spaces that are shaped around the people who own and occupy them.
Abi Munslow leads the team with a people-first view of design.

She creates dynamic, collaborative places made to bring out the best in people. Spaces built to enable growth, shaped for ambitious brands who treat the workplace as more than a backdrop. A fiery creative passion runs through the team, matched turn for turn by laser-focused commercial thinking and delivery.

main: Curate sits between the strategic rigour of traditional architecture & the cost, pace and certainty of modern D&B solutions. Not a compromise between the two. A position that draws on both.
Liam Spencer leads a team of Designers, Architects and Furniture Consultants drawn from globally renowned practices.

Together, they curate the best of both: the rigour of traditional architecture, the certainty of D&B. Concept work comes first and sharp with pointed narratives, embedded sustainability and a real care for detailing, finish and material. Commercial transparency is evident throughout, in design that earns its ambition, on budget and on time.

main: Boutique is known for creating high-end spaces that balance elegance with timeless craft. Refined environments, in some of London’s most distinctive buildings.
Trish Watson leads the team on the highest shared standards: thoughtful, polished and highly ambitious.

The team create places that carry a quiet authority, with a level of taste and sophistication that signals quality outwards, while placing as much value on an attentive experience as on the final outcome. It's why owners and occupiers both return to Boutique, time and time again.
